coordinate_interpretation.accepted_step0: Actual accepted MRVPACK2 Float32 world-coordinate values; treated as metres.
coordinate_interpretation.extent_definition: Maximum Euclidean distance among exact intersection-polygon vertices for each pair; isolated point extent is zero. Exact classification and threshold counts use rational lattice arithmetic; distribution lengths are meter values converted from the common Float32 lattice.
coordinate_interpretation.not_claimed: The source mesh is not a person-specific measurement; it is BodyParts3D-derived geometry stored in metres. Source-vs-pose comparisons are by stable ID and face row, and compare extents (translation/rotation invariant), not absolute positions.
coordinate_interpretation.source: NHTISS4 Float32 xyz values are consumed as stored; the model compiler converts raw BodyParts3D source millimetres to stored_vertices_m before Float32 packing (model.py 11704, 11733). The prior clarification says this audit does not establish the payload coordinate-frame tag; no transform was applied.

method.predicate: Pinned cardiac_cavity_intersections.triangle_intersection_points on integer 2**149 Float32 lattice keys; affine rank gives point/segment/area type; no approximate intersections.
method.quantiles: linear interpolation at p50 and p95 over pairwise maximum extents
method.thresholds: strictly below each named threshold; exact squared-rational comparison

qualification: Diagnostic classification of retained self-witnesses only. It does not revalidate omitted pairs, classify biological significance, or establish that contacts are harmless.
scope: Reclassified only the 2,964 face-pair witness records retained by audit 1213. Recomputed each pair with the pinned exact Float32 lattice triangle_intersection_points predicate. No full mesh scan, native execution, GPU work, geometry edits, or added tolerance.

source_to_accepted_step0.classification: Only 1213 authored-source and accepted step-0 pose records exist; no later native poses are represented by this ledger.
